spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ ٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا EN: O Prophet, fear Allah and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites.

[12] AR: وَإِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ مَّا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ إِلَّا غُرُورًۭا EN: And [remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said, "Allah and His Messenger did not promise us except delusion,"

folded.subject: among you
folded.object: those [hypocrites] who say to their brothers

spans.text: [18] AR: ۞ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُعَوِّقِينَ مِنكُمْ وَٱلْقَآئِلِينَ لِإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ هَلُمَّ إِلَيْنَا ۖ وَلَا يَأْتُونَ ٱلْبَأْسَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا EN: Already Allah knows the hinderers among you and those [hypocrites] who say to their brothers, "Come to us," and do not go to battle, except for a few,

folded.id: and ever|is|allah forgiving and merciful
folded.subject: And ever
folded.object: Allah Forgiving and Merciful

spans.text: And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
And ever is Allah, of what you do, Seeing.

folded.id: and ever|is|that
folded.subject: and ever
folded.object: that

spans.text: Those have not believed, so Allah has rendered their deeds worthless, and ever is that, for Allah, easy.

folded.id: and sufficient|is|allah as disposer of affairs
folded.subject: and sufficient
folded.object: Allah as Disposer of affairs

spans.text: [3] AR: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًۭا EN: And rely upon Allah; and sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.
And ever is the promise to Allah [that about which one will be] questioned.

folded.id: and there|is|no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended
folded.subject: And there
folded.object: no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended

spans.text: And there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended.

[13] AR: وَإِذْ قَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَٱرْجِعُوا۟ ۚ وَيَسْتَـْٔذِنُ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُمُ ٱلنَّبِىَّ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوْرَةٌۭ وَمَا هِىَ بِعَوْرَةٍ ۖ إِن يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِرَارًۭا EN: And when a faction of them said, "O people of Yathrib, there is no stability for you [here], so return [home]."

folded.id: and those|of|[blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of allah than the [other] believers and the emigrants
folded.subject: And those
folded.object: [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allah than the [other] believers and the emigrants

spans.text: And those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allah than the [other] believers and the emigrants, except that you may do to your close associates a kindness [through bequest].

folded.id: done it|and|not hesitated over it except briefly
folded.subject: done it
folded.object: not hesitated over it except briefly

spans.text: [14] AR: وَلَوْ دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَقْطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُئِلُوا۟ ٱلْفِتْنَةَ لَءَاتَوْهَا وَمَا تَلَبَّثُوا۟ بِهَآ إِلَّا يَسِيرًۭا EN: And if they had been entered upon from all its [surrounding] regions and fitnah had been demanded of them, they would have done it and not hesitated over it except briefly.

folded.id: fear allah|and|do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites
folded.subject: fear Allah
folded.object: do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ ٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا EN: O Prophet, fear Allah and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites.

[12] AR: وَإِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ مَّا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ إِلَّا غُرُورًۭا EN: And [remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said, "Allah and His Messenger did not promise us except delusion,"

folded.id: in religion|and|those entrusted to you
folded.subject: in religion
folded.object: those entrusted to you

spans.text: But if you do not know their fathers - then they are [still] your brothers in religion and those entrusted to you.

folded.id: it|is|more just in the sight of allah
folded.subject: it
folded.object: more just in the sight of Allah

spans.text: [5] AR: ٱدْعُوهُمْ لِءَابَآئِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَمَوَٰلِيكُمْ ۚ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌۭ فِيمَآ أَخْطَأْتُم بِهِۦ وَلَٰكِن مَّا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًا EN: Call them by [the names of] their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allah.

folded.id: o people|of|yathrib
folded.subject: O people
folded.object: Yathrib

spans.text: [13] AR: وَإِذْ قَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَٱرْجِعُوا۟ ۚ وَيَسْتَـْٔذِنُ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْهُمُ ٱلنَّبِىَّ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوْرَةٌۭ وَمَا هِىَ بِعَوْرَةٍ ۖ إِن يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِرَارًۭا EN: And when a faction of them said, "O people of Yathrib, there is no stability for you [here], so return [home]."

folded.id: regions|and|fitnah had been demanded of them
folded.subject: regions
folded.object: fitnah had been demanded of them

spans.text: [14] AR: وَلَوْ دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَقْطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُئِلُوا۟ ٱلْفِتْنَةَ لَءَاتَوْهَا وَمَا تَلَبَّثُوا۟ بِهَآ إِلَّا يَسِيرًۭا EN: And if they had been entered upon from all its [surrounding] regions and fitnah had been demanded of them, they would have done it and not hesitated over it except briefly.

folded.id: that which|is|revealed to you from your lord
folded.subject: that which
folded.object: revealed to you from your Lord

spans.text: [2] AR: وَٱتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًۭا EN: And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord.

folded.id: that|is|[merely] your saying by your mouths
folded.subject: That
folded.object: [merely] your saying by your mouths

spans.text: That is [merely] your saying by your mouths, but Allah says the truth, and He guides to the [right] way.

folded.id: the favor|of|allah upon you when armies came to [attack] you and we sent upon them a wind and armies [of angels] you did not see
folded.subject: the favor
folded.object: Allah upon you when armies came to [attack] you and We sent upon them a wind and armies [of angels] you did not see

spans.text: [9] AR: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَآءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌۭ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا وَجُنُودًۭا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا EN: O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allah upon you when armies came to [attack] you and We sent upon them a wind and armies [of angels] you did not see.

folded.id: the hypocrites|and|those in whose hearts is disease said
folded.subject: the hypocrites
folded.object: those in whose hearts is disease said

spans.text: [12] AR: وَإِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ مَّا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ إِلَّا غُرُورًۭا EN: And [remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said, "Allah and His Messenger did not promise us except delusion,"

folded.id: the messenger|of|allah an excellent pattern for anyo
folded.subject: the Messenger
folded.object: Allah an excellent pattern for anyo

spans.text: [21] AR: لَّقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِى رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌۭ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْءَاخِرَ وَذَكَرَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا EN: There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allah an excellent pattern for anyo

folded.id: the prophet|is|more worthy of the believers than themselves
folded.subject: The Prophet
folded.object: more worthy of the believers than themselves

spans.text: [6] AR: ٱلنَّبِىُّ أَوْلَىٰ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُۥٓ أُمَّهَٰتُهُمْ ۗ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِبَعْضٍۢ فِى كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُهَٰجِرِينَ إِلَّآ أَن تَفْعَلُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَوْلِيَآئِكُم مَّعْرُوفًۭا ۚ كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَسْطُورًۭا EN: The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves, and his wives are [in the position of] their mothers.

folded.id: the son|of|mary
folded.subject: the son
folded.object: Mary

spans.text: [7] AR: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِيثَٰقَهُمْ وَمِنكَ وَمِن نُّوحٍۢ وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ ۖ وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُم مِّيثَٰقًا غَلِيظًۭا EN: And [mention, O Muhammad], when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus, the son of Mary; and We took from them a solemn covenant.

folded.id: the throats|and|you assumed about allah [various] assumptions
folded.subject: the throats
folded.object: you assumed about Allah [various] assumptions

spans.text: [10] AR: إِذْ جَآءُوكُم مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ وَبَلَغَتِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلظُّنُونَا۠ EN: [Remember] when they came at you from above you and from below you, and when eyes shifted [in fear], and hearts reached the throats and you assumed about Allah [various] assumptions.

folded.id: their backs|and|flee
folded.subject: their backs
folded.object: flee

spans.text: [15] AR: وَلَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ عَٰهَدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مِن قَبْلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ ٱلْأَدْبَٰرَ ۚ وَكَانَ عَهْدُ ٱللَّهِ مَسْـُٔولًۭا EN: And they had already promised Allah before not to turn their backs and flee.

folded.id: they|did|not intend except to flee
folded.subject: They
folded.object: not intend except to flee

spans.text: They did not intend except to flee.

folded.id: were tested|and|shaken with a severe shaking
folded.subject: were tested
folded.object: shaken with a severe shaking

spans.text: [11] AR: هُنَالِكَ ٱبْتُلِىَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوا۟ زِلْزَالًۭا شَدِيدًۭا EN: There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking.

folded.id: when we|took|from the prophets their covenant and from you and from noah and abraham and moses and jesus
folded.subject: when We
folded.object: from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus

spans.text: [7] AR: وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِيثَٰقَهُمْ وَمِنكَ وَمِن نُّوحٍۢ وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ ۖ وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُم مِّيثَٰقًا غَلِيظًۭا EN: And [mention, O Muhammad], when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus, the son of Mary; and We took from them a solemn covenant.

folded.id: who|is|it that can protect you from allah if he intends for you an ill or intends for you a mercy?"
folded.subject: Who
folded.object: it that can protect you from Allah if He intends for you an ill or intends for you a mercy?"

spans.text: [17] AR: قُلْ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَعْصِمُكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ سُوٓءًا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ ۚ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيًّۭا وَلَا نَصِيرًۭا EN: Say, "Who is it that can protect you from Allah if He intends for you an ill or intends for you a mercy?"
